Title: Implement per-tool model routing policy (analysis vs codegen vs reasoning)
Description: Each tool type should declare a preferred model/routing policy. Analysis tools (review_code, explain_code) → qcoder:latest on Fast node. Code generation tools (refactor_code, generate_tests, document_code) → qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct. Reasoning/multi-step tools (agent_task, plan_task) → deepseek-r1:7b on Deep node. Embeddings → nomic-embed-text. Implement via RoutingHint field on InferenceRequest or per-tool RoutingOptions in config. Three external evaluators independently reached this conclusion.
